title: 第4章 巫师学徒之威
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
傍晚，生日晚宴。

    侯爵府主堡巨大的宴会厅亮如白昼，水晶吊灯折射璀璨光芒，悠扬的弦乐流淌。

    伊森一身藏蓝色礼服，在主位旁落座。身边是家族内几位长辈，领地的重要官员和封地骑士分坐长桌两侧。

    珍馐美馔流水般呈上。

    “伊森少爷，”坐在他左侧，胡须花白的老财政官端起酒杯，“再次祝您生日快乐！愿诸神庇佑您十日后的测试，为里奥家族带来新的荣光！”

    老财政官话音未落，原本温暖融洽的宴会厅如同被瞬间冻结。

    弦乐骤停，觥筹交错的声响消失，所有谈笑凝固在脸上，化为一片死寂。

    “诸神”！

    伊森脸上的温和笑容瞬间消失。

    他猛地看向老财政官，眼神锐利如刀。

    下一秒——

    “砰！”

    伊森手中的水晶酒杯重重砸在桌上，酒液四溅。

    “拿下！”

    无需多余解释，宴会厅角落阴影里，两名身着黑色皮甲的精锐骑士如猎豹般扑出。

    一人反剪老财政官双臂，另一人利落地用特制软布堵住他的嘴。

    整个过程发生在电光火石之间。

    老财政官甚至来不及挣扎，就被牢牢控制住，拖离座位。

    “唔！唔唔！”他惊恐地瞪大眼，含糊不清的求饶声被堵在喉咙里。

    整个宴会厅落针可闻。

    所有宾客脸色煞白，噤若寒蝉。

    伊森缓缓站起身，目光扫过全场，那股属于上位贵族的压迫感弥漫开来。

    “福特。”

    老福特无声无息地出现在伊森身侧，躬身聆听。

    “立刻审讯。查明是年老昏聩的口误，还是受人蛊惑，或者......有其他不轨之心。”

    “是，少爷。”
content_en:
In the evening, birthday dinner.

    The huge banquet hall of the Marquis Palace is as bright as day, with crystal chandeliers reflecting bright light and melodious string music flowing.

    Ethan was wearing a navy blue dress and sat down next to the main seat. Next to him were several elders in the family, important officials of the territory and knights of the fief sitting on both sides of the long table.

    Delicious delicacies are served like water.

    "Master Ethan," the old financial officer with a gray beard sitting on his left held up his wine glass, "I wish you a happy birthday again! May the gods bless your test in ten days and bring new glory to the Leo family!"

    Before the old financial officer finished speaking, the originally warm and harmonious banquet hall seemed to be frozen in an instant.

    The strings suddenly stopped, the sounds of people drinking and drinking disappeared, and all the chatter and laughter froze on the faces, turning into a dead silence.

    "Gods"!

    The gentle smile on Ethan's face disappeared instantly.

    He looked sharply at the old financial officer, his eyes as sharp as knives.

    The next second——

    "Bang!"

    The crystal wine glass in Ethan's hand hit the table hard, and the wine splashed everywhere.

    "Take it!"

    No unnecessary explanation is needed. From the shadows in the corner of the banquet hall, two elite knights in black leather armor pounced like cheetahs.

    One person cut off the old financial officer's arms from behind his back, while the other neatly blocked his mouth with a special soft cloth.

    The whole process happened in a flash of lightning.

    The old financial officer didn't even have time to struggle before he was firmly controlled and dragged out of his seat.

    "Uh! Uh-huh!" His eyes widened in horror, and his muffled begging for mercy was stuck in his throat.

    The entire banquet hall could be heard.

    All the guests turned pale and remained silent.

    Ethan stood up slowly, his eyes sweeping across the whole place, and the oppressive feeling belonging to the upper-class nobles filled the air.

    "Ford."

    Old Ford appeared silently beside Ethan, bowing to listen.

    "Interrogate him immediately. Find out whether it was a slip of the tongue due to old age and confusion, or whether he was deceived, or... he has other evil intentions."

    "Yes, Master."
title_en: Chapter 4 The Power of the Wizard’s Apprentice
